name: evidence-viewer-unselected
goal: Give the standalone image viewer a truthful unselected state while galleries close quietly.

evidence: At 5f6aac9f7e the viewer renders no DOM when selected is null, so its unselected state cannot produce a nonblank component capture. Show an unselected message without leaving it in gallery views after close.

The catalog tests open and navigate the viewer but omit initial null selection and close. Add both existing component scenario states and assert that grid and entity-state galleries remain quiet and reopen correctly.
